services.desc: About >Come experience a local tradition! Our popular fully narrated cruise of the Great Harbor of Mount Desert (including the Cranberry Islands) and Somes Sound Fjord has operated and been a highlight of visitors to the region for more than 40 years! > Superb views of Bear Island Lighthouse, nesting osprey and basking harbor seals framed by Acadia’s dramatic mountains comprise the first portion of the cruise. A highlight of the middle of the trip is a 45-minute stop (exact timing may be adjusted depending on the time of year) at the 200-year-old lobster fishing village of Little Cranberry Island. services.name: Seals, Fjord & More Cruise
services.desc: About >Join us for late afternoon cruise to visit some of our most popular attractions! See the seals playing in the water and basking on the ledges of East Bunker ledge. Cruise into the breathtaking Somes Sound fjord where majestic mountains with vertical cliffs rise directly out of the sea and the Man-O-War Brook cascades into the serene waters. Included in the trip are the views of Bear Island Lighthouse, an osprey’s nest, abundant wildlife, and impressive views of Mount Desert Island. The Seals & Fjord Cruise is narrated by one of our experienced professional local naturalists with many years of experience conducting cruises on the Sea Princess. Available Times >4:00 PM Departure

services.name: Sunset Cruise
services.desc: About >The mountains of Acadia and the breathtaking Cranberry Isles provide the perfect backdrop for dramatic sunsets mirrored across the sea. Some cruise highlights may also include Somes Sound Fjord, Southwest Harbor, Bear Island Lighthouse, and exciting wildlife. Please feel free to bring aboard a picnic and beverages of your choice to enjoy while underway. The Sunset Cruise is narrated by one of our experienced professional local naturalists with many years of experience conducting cruises on the Sea Princess.
